items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: And Jim Robinson's brother by the name of Effie Robinson was playing bass violin.

ctx.x: But uh, he could play. He was a wonderful trumpet player. Do you remember who else was in his band when you would hear him up here in the city or down there in the country too?

Well, no. In the country, I couldn't exactly tell you who all, yeah I can tell you too who all was in the band or he's in the country. Jim Robinson. Jim Robinson was playing. Jim was everything down there. Yeah, Jim was playing uh, Ghetto. He used to get to all that time. And they had uh, Jim Robinson's nephew. Sydney Brown was playing violin. Leading violin. Yeah. And Jim Robinson's brother by the name of Effie Robinson was playing bass violin. And they had another brother died called Sammy Robinson was playing…
Kelly's band in the country yeah he still live yeah he still leaves back
